newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MWE to raise stake in stockbroking group.
newsitem.headline: MWE to raise stake in stockbroking group.

text.p: Malaysia's MWE Holdings Bhd said on Wednesday it has agreed to acquire an additional 21 percent stake in Y.K. Fung Holdings Sdn Bhd for 22 million ringgit in cash.

The proposed acquisition will increase MWE's shareholding in Y.K. Fung to 51 percent, making it mandatory for MWE to extend a general offer for the remaining shares in Y.K. Fung which it does not own.
Y.K. Fung Holdings owns 80 percent of stockbroking firm Y.K. Fung Securities Sdn Bhd.

Property and construction based MWE said in a statement that the acquisition, to be financed from internally generated funds and through bank borrowings, was in line with the group's strategy of broadening its earnings base.
